briefing.headline: xAI deploys Grok-4 with 2T parameters as OpenAI readies o4 launch

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing scaled models this month. Compute constraints and safety gaps remain primary bottlenecks. Multi-agent coordination is emerging as the decisive capability.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI released Grok-4 achieving new SOTA on AgentBench. OpenAI's o4 is in final testing with improved long-horizon planning. DeepSeek-V3 and Meta's Llama-4-405B also shipped updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST released new red-teaming guidelines for multi-agent deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced 200k H200 cluster in Texas. TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips for Google and Amazon.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like DialectForge be adopted before the first widely deployed autonomous agent fleets?
